RequestBody.input: Could you please create bar chart in TRANSPORTATION sector for the operating profit from the uploaded csv file and provide file to me?

output.code:
# Read the uploaded CSV and inspect its contents
import pandas as pd

fp = "/mnt/data/assistant-6WZY9iRD6xQEDUxpsQxGC5-synthetic_500_quarterly_results.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(fp)

# show basic info
info = {
    "rows": df.shape[0],
    "columns": df.shape[1],
    "column_names": list(df.columns)
}

df_head = df.head(10)
info, df_head.style.set_caption("First 10 rows of the CSV")

# Filter TRANSPORTATION sector rows
transport_df = df[df['sector'].str.upper() == 'TRANSPORTATION'].copy()
transport_df_style = transport_df[['name', 'NSE_code', 'operating_profit', 'operating_profit_margin', 'net_profit']]
transport_df_style.reset_index(drop=True, inplace=True)
transport_df_style.style.set_caption("TRANSPORTATION sector rows")

# Create bar chart for operating_profit in TRANSPORTATION sector and save the image
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Prepare data
plot_df = transport_df.copy()
plot_df['operating_profit'] = pd.to_numeric(plot_df['operating_profit'], errors='coerce')

x = plot_df['name']
y = plot_df['operating_profit']

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
bars = plt.bar(x, y, color='tab:blue')
plt.xlabel('Company')
plt.ylabel('Operating Profit (in crores)')  # unit not specified in file, assuming numeric units
plt.title('Operating Profit - TRANSPORTATION Sector')
plt.xticks(rotation=30, ha='right')
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Add value labels on top of bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    plt.annotate(f'{height:.1f}',
                 xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                 xytext=(0, 4),  # 4 points vertical offset
                 textcoords="offset points",
                 ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()

out_path = "/mnt/data/transportation_operating_profit_bar.png"
plt.savefig(out_path, dpi=150)
plt.show()

out_path
